label: Closed esse-source transfer controls
paraphrase: Exact interpretations only: a directly rooted infinite chain and a rooted dependent cycle satisfy CCR, distinct-esse coverage, identity-bearer uniqueness, two actual beings and the common-source conclusion. The infinite-chain interpretation violates unrestricted well-foundedness. An isolated identity root beside a rootless chain satisfies coverage, uniqueness, population and whole-roster root existence, but violates CCR and common ancestry. A singleton satisfies one-bearer population without two actual beings. These are logical controls, not metaphysical counterexamples.
